name: check-and-units
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check; bun test core/count-witness.test.ts core/counts-structured.test.ts core/count-unions.test.ts core/count-focus-proof.test.ts core/count-support.test.ts core/field-laws.test.ts

name: paxos
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --only paxos_epr --skip broken --ms 60000 | tee /tmp/track-gen-paxos.jsonl; bun -e 'const r=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("/tmp/track-gen-paxos.jsonl","utf8").trim());if(r.search.verdict!=="proven")throw Error(r.search.verdict)'
